v0_1_termination.reason: The confirmatory cohort was frozen before clean environment and behavioral candidate qualification. Continuing the frozen stream would primarily measure benchmark materialization failures rather than the planned C0-C3 reviewer-agent response effect.
v0_1_termination.paper_use_boundary: P3/P4 v0.1 records are protocol-feasibility and engineering provenance only. They cannot enter v0.2 confirmatory estimates, model-result tables, or effectiveness claims.

v0_2_design.one_sentence_argument: On a task-disjoint cohort qualified before confirmatory freeze, estimate how cumulative genuinely executed evidence from C0 through C3 changes a fixed reviewer agent's accept, reject, and escalate policy for paired oracle-positive and hard-negative patches, with claims limited to the frozen cohort, model routes, and run window.
v0_2_design.agent_boundary: A reviewer agent is one frozen model endpoint executing one neutral prompt and one JSON output schema without autonomous tools; it receives only the supplied cumulative evidence packet.

primary_estimands.name: Delta_minus
primary_estimands.formula: P(accept | C3, hard-negative) - P(accept | C0, hard-negative)

primary_estimands.name: Delta_plus
primary_estimands.formula: P(accept | C3, oracle-positive) - P(accept | C0, oracle-positive)

construction_protocol.source_reuse_boundary: Tasks with no v0.1 candidate/model outcome may be reconsidered under v0.2. The five v0.1 P4-active tasks are development-only and excluded from the v0.2 confirmatory cohort.
environment_policy: Use a project-level recipe frozen before task checks; do not require byte-for-byte execution of decayed benchmark setup metadata.
A recipe may install declared runtime/test dependencies and the project itself, but must apply identically to all attempted tasks in that project.
Do not add a task-specific dependency or compatibility repair after observing that task's qualification outcome.
Run both candidate roles in the same frozen task image and bind every visible command/result to its image and dependency-lock hashes.
candidate_policy: The oracle-positive candidate must pass all basic, visible, and hidden checks in two fresh isolated runs.
Generate partial-fix candidates in a frozen deterministic order before observing model output.
Select the first generated candidate that passes syntax/basic and every visible check but fails at least one independent hidden check in two fresh isolated runs.
If no generated candidate qualifies, record the task as pre-confirmatory materialization failure and continue in frozen task order; do not reinterpret or manually repair the candidate.
construction_protocol.cohort_freeze_rule: Freeze the first 30 fully qualified task pairs in the preregistered task order. If the eligible source frame is exhausted first, stop before P3 v0.2 and before every model call.

phases.purpose: Terminate v0.1 without changing its frozen artifacts and approve the v0.2 design direction.
Freeze and author-sign the source, environment, candidate-generation, qualification, exclusion, and stop rules before materialization.
Materialize and dual-run pre-model candidate pairs mechanically until 30 tasks qualify or the source frame is exhausted.
Freeze the exact cohort, evidence packets, prompt/schema, model routes, estimands, statistics, order, retry limits, cost, and run window; obtain author signoff.
Render all C0-C3 packets and pass schema, cumulative-evidence, identity-hiding, leakage, scheduling, and cost preflight audits.
Run bounded smoke and then the frozen reviewer-agent model experiment.
phases.activation_condition: V2-P1 through V2-P4 passed, V2-P3 author signoff recorded, exact model routes reverified, and a separate execution Goal is active.

phases.purpose: Join hidden labels after output freeze, compute preregistered effects, and revise the paper with bounded claims.

preserved_scientific_elements: three models and three stateless repeats
must_be_refrozen_after_materialization: exact model identifiers, parameters, prices, and access
request ordering, retry/attempt/cost/token caps, and run window
statistical seed and executable analysis plan
claim_boundary: Estimate evidence-conditioned reviewer-agent decision-policy changes; do not claim autonomous verification or repair correctness.
Report both primary effects together and retain null, adverse, heterogeneous, or wide-interval results.
Do not estimate deployment prevalence or generalize beyond the frozen tasks, routes, and run window.
P3/P4 v0.1 feasibility records cannot be pooled with v0.2 model outcomes.
